### 💡 Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is (e.g. *I'm always frustrated when...*).

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

Add screenshots, design mockups, or description of the overlay / dashboard appearance.

### 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

- [ ] Spotify Integration
- [ ] Twitch / Kick / TikTok Chat Command Parser
- [ ] Queue Management & Moderation

### 🤝 Additional Context
Add any other context, links to APIs, or streaming setup details here.
